'''Rroot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was captured and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] from the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. His mother hired a spacer to rescue him.
